assessment: By integrating a range of computational techniques, the authors made an important contribution by generating a structural model for the AT3 domain, which is predicted to adopt a new fold. The key features of the structural model are consistent with the activity of the enzyme as an acyltransferase, with a transmembrane channel that can accommodate an acyl-CoA donor, and an outer cavity formed with a second domain that can accommodate a nascent LPS molecule as substrate. Overall, the study is valuable as it will help stimulate specific experimental analyses that will further evaluate and improve the model for better mechanistic understanding of this class of enzymes.
